teaching_language: Set by the accepting Japanese university: applicants need enough Japanese or English to work with their advisor, and up to six months of Japanese preparatory education is given where needed

milestones.label: Call for applications opens at each Japanese embassy or consulate (2027 intake)
milestones.source_text: The official MEXT application guidelines say the call opens around mid-April 2026 at each Japanese mission; each mission sets its own submission deadline.

milestones.label: Application deadline (set by each Japanese embassy or consulate)
milestones.source_text: The official guidelines say the closing date, first-screening dates and result dates differ from one Japanese mission to another, so applicants must check their own mission.

milestones.label: Notification of final selection and university placement
milestones.source_text: The official guidelines schedule final results, sent through the Japanese mission, for January to March 2027.
